name: Hannu

wants.text: No incident he has to explain
His son’s place at the harbor school
wants.stake: The only future he can buy

fears: being blamed for someone else's cargo
contradiction: He enforces rules he thinks are foolish.

provenance.notes: An invented official in a documented institution.

voice.register: Bureaucratic, terse, numbers before names. Dry mercy when he thinks no one is looking.
tics: wetting a stylus he does not need
turning the board so it cannot be read
sampleLines: Name. Cargo. And whether you have been in this harbor before.
Eat something. The palace does not bargain with the tired.
